entities.name: Resveratrol
observations: Post-injury resveratrol reduced hippocampal neuron loss or pathology in rodent TBI studies; the strongest direct result was in 7-day-old rats.

entities.name: Traumatic brain injury
observations: Experimental contusion, falling-weight, and weight-drop models were used in rats.

entities.name: Hippocampal neuron rescue
observations: In 7-day-old rat pups with contusion TBI, one immediate 100 mg/kg intraperitoneal dose significantly ameliorated ipsilateral and contralateral hippocampal neuron loss at 2 weeks; effect size and cell counts were not reported in the abstract.

entities.name: TBI hippocampal pathology
observations: Separate rat TBI studies reported improved hippocampal pathology or neuronal healing with resveratrol; neuronal survival was not quantified in the available summaries.

entities.name: PMID:17531385
observations: Reported significant reduction in hippocampal neuron loss after post-injury resveratrol in immature rats with contusion TBI.

entities.name: PMID:27509464
observations: Moderate rat TBI study; resveratrol lowered oxidative DNA damage and MDA, with neuronal healing concluded by the authors but no quantified neuronal survival reported in the available abstract.

entities.name: PMID:38189498
observations: Rat weight-drop TBI study; oral resveratrol alleviated hippocampal pathology and NFκB upregulation, without quantified neuronal rescue in the available abstract.
